acceptance_criteria: AC-1 A configuration_collect job for a Check Point device (fake transport, fixture in the measured shape) records one run with canonical hash over set lines, withheld count equal to the fixture's secret-bearing lines, a section index, a sanitized text artefact, and an encrypted raw artefact whose recorded hash equals the fixture's; a second identical run is marked unchanged.

AC-2 For a Palo Alto device, effective-running of several megabytes is processed as a stream (test asserts no full-document String is materialised, e.g. by a bounded-memory or streaming-parser assertion) into the category index per vsys and an encrypted, gzip-compressed raw artefact; active and merged are recorded as their own read kinds.

AC-2a A Palo Alto fixture with src attributes yields per-source counts per category and an override list for src=local elements; the Panorama cross-check fixture names the template / device-group source for each override; a notification is recorded per device per run and the view marks the categories; a fixture without local elements records no_local_override.

AC-3 Gate entries documents exist per literal; V16 seeds SIGNED_OFF rows; both capability specs resolve executionEligible (test); admission refuses DRAFT and admits ENROLLED (test); WorkerClaimLoop lists the two capabilities.

AC-4 The four routes return the specified shapes and codes; the Configuration screen lists devices, shows the index and withheld count, shows Check Point sanitized text, and Collect now admits and polls (vitest).

AC-5 Manifests declare the artefact-store key by reference only (manifest tests updated and green); eleven-module build, worker/job-engine/persistence/service/architecture/frontend tests, privacy gate and contract_authority_status green; PanoramaAssignmentReducer fixture test green.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Streaming XML processing with encryption at rest, a C7 artefact store, a new job kind and a screen; high effort earns its cost on the streaming and key handling.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.
Every public type names the clause it implements (14G CG-n, 13F CF-n, C7 section n, C2 section n).
Do NOT use './ui2/gradlew -p ui2 build' without '-x :integration-tests:test'. Do not run the full Python pytest suite. Eleven Gradle subprojects. V16 only, additive.

No configuration content, address, hostname, serial or secret in logs, exception messages, audit rows or fixtures (fixtures are synthetic with documentation addresses); the raw copy exists only encrypted in the artefact store.
If a contract clause and this packet disagree, raise a RELAY_QUESTION and STOP; never weaken GateResolver, a direction test or a closed-set test.
No emoji, no tool-identifying footer, no external URL in commits, the PR or code comments.

Commit early and often (V16 + repositories + artefact store; gates + YAML; worker; service; frontend). Open the PR at the end; do not merge. SESSION_CLOSE names the tables, the artefact store implementation and its key handling, the capability ids, the routes with status codes, the screen components, and test counts before and after.
risks: Reading effective-running into a String (11.8 MB measured; larger estates exist).
Hashing the raw Check Point text as the canonical hash (timestamp header) -- canonical is set lines only.
Storing the raw copy unencrypted or logging a configuration line on error.
Repeating the Gaia read per virtual system (measured identical; wasteful and misleading).
